column2: step durations are WALL CLOCK across await points, not CPU time:
a step that awaits I/O accrues the wait, and other tasks may run
inside that span. That is the intended measure for head-of-line
delay; do not read a large step as CPU cost.
arm_starvation is measured directly as (entry time - the deadline
the interval scheduled the tick for). It is NOT derived from
tick_entry_gap, which carries no starvation signal by itself:
under a steady delay every gap is exactly one tick period.
